name: Content Heal AI Crawler Protection & Honeypot Shield
author: piyushsingh14

sections.description:
Content Heal AI Gateway protects your WordPress website from unauthorized AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Bytespider, and 50+ others) while automatically monetizing verified AI bot traffic via HTTP 402 Pay-Per-Crawl micropayments.

Features:
* Automatic injection for real-time edge telemetry.
* Invisible honeypot trap in wp_footer to capture and ban brute-force scrapers.
* Server-side template_redirect interception with sub-millisecond bot identification.
* Real-time verification with the Content Heal Gateway API.
* Immediate HTTP 402 Payment Required JSON response for uncredited bots.
* Full compatibility with WordPress caching plugins, Cloudflare, and CDNs.

Pre-configured Publisher Owner ID: b40c74d3-6fef-49f1-b22b-afb207358f0e

External Services

This plugin communicates with our remote edge verification gateway to inspect crawler bot requests, verify prepaid API credentials, and log honeypot access:

  1. Verification and Threat Gateway APIs

* Endpoints:
– https://content-heal-studio.vercel.app/api/verify-bot
– https://content-heal-studio.vercel.app/api/bot-signatures
– https://content-heal-studio.vercel.app/api/trap
* Service Provider: Content Heal (https://content-heal-studio.vercel.app)
* Data Transmitted: When an incoming request matches a known AI crawler (e.g., GPTBot) or triggers the invisible honeypot trap, the plugin sends client IP address, User-Agent header string, requested URL path, and Authorization Bearer header (if provided).
* Purpose: Verifies whether the automated crawler holds valid authorization keys to access content and logs honeypot scraper violations. Standard residential human visitors experience zero external network calls.
* Terms of Use: https://content-heal-studio.vercel.app/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://content-heal-studio.vercel.app/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Download content-heal-ai-crawler-protection-honeypot-shield.zip from your Content Heal Studio dashboard.
  2. In WordPress Admin, navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose content-heal-ai-crawler-protection-honeypot-shield.zip, click Install Now, and Activate Plugin.
  4. Go to Settings > Content Heal to verify your Publisher Owner ID and configured endpoints.

How to get Publisher Owner ID
Don’t have a Publisher Owner ID yet?
1. Create a free account at https://content-heal-studio.vercal.app
2. Copy your 1-Click Publisher UUID from your dashboard
3. Paste it below to activate edge firewall protection
👉 Get Your Free Publisher ID Now] (Opens in new tab)
sections.faq:
Does this slow down my website for human visitors?

No. Human visitors and standard search engine crawlers pass through without any interference. The server-side interception hook exits early for human traffic.

What happens when an unauthorized AI crawler visits?

The gateway immediately halts execution, returning an HTTP 402 Payment Required JSON response with pricing and authorization instructions.

Where do I find my Publisher Owner ID?

Your Publisher Owner ID is pre-configured in this package (b40c74d3-6fef-49f1-b22b-afb207358f0e) and can also be found in your Content Heal Studio dashboard under the Integration tab.
